📏 ELI5 Kata · Range Extraction (Haskell + Julia + ASM, 4 kyu)

How do we compress `[-6,-3,-2,-1,0,1,3,4,5]` into `"-6,-3-1,3-5"` where only runs of 3+ consecutive integers become `a-b`?

https://github.com/8b-is/space-bender/tree/main/katas/4kyu/range-extraction

🔍 ELI5 Step 1 (The 3-Number Rule):

Walk consecutive neighbors `y == prev + 1` from `a` to `b`:
• Span `b - a >= 2` (3+ numbers): collapse to `"a-b"`
• Span `b - a == 1` (just 2 numbers): keep separate `"a,b"`
• Span `0` (single number): emit `"a"`!

⚡ ELI5 Step 2 (Haskell + Julia + Zero-Libc Assembly):

• Haskell (`solution.hs`): `spanRun` + `intercalate ","`
• Julia (`solution.jl`): two-pointer run scanner
• x86-64 NASM & ARM64 (`solution.asm`, `solution_arm64.s`): pure register `div`/`udiv` ASCII digit streamer!

✅ Verified across Haskell (GHC 9.14), Julia 1.13, x86-64 NASM & ARM64!
